item.title: Keeping the lights on and hopes high through solar power in Milne Bay
item.description: Backed by community action, almost 800 household solar kits have been installed in Deboyne Islands, Milne Bay. The power and newly installed lighting is helping households save money, improve community health and safety, support learning, and create more time for social and income-generating activities.
